summary: My share (the 69 GB2312, EUC-KR, EUC-TW, IBM855 and IBM866 encoding-detection tests) passes on the last check, but I made no edits: other fixers concurrently fixed the multibyte and single-byte probers and the UTF-8 state table. The last full-suite run gave 375 passed and 1 failed (test_detect_all_and_detect_one_should_agree: on input a\x80\x0f, detect returns None while detect_all reports utf-8, because the MBCS group marks the UTF-8 prober NOT_ME), which is outside my share.
